description: This file defines the gl::Buffer class and related classes such as BufferState, implementing OpenGL buffer objects, their state management, and related functionality within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: BufferState
classes.description: Manages the state of a GL buffer, including usage, size, access flags, and binding counts.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL buffer object, including data management, binding state, and implementation details.

methods.name: bufferData
methods.description: Uploads data to the buffer object.

methods.name: bufferSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of the buffer data.

methods.name: copyBufferSubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer object.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for access.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for drawing.
